## What changed

- **Simpler workspace controls.** Click the eyes to open or close the in-chat workspace; double-click to move it to the desktop and back. Desktop windows remember their always-on-top choice.
- **Less visual clutter.** Show toolbar and refresh actions on hover or keyboard focus. Keep drag arrangement and double-click focus without duplicate controls.
- **Suggestions and notes.** Restore valid suggestions when returning to a chat during the same run. Fix sidebar changes triggered by editing or deleting chat notes.
- **Settings and theme.** Open grouped web settings directly and follow Codex colors without changing the host appearance.
- **Model switching.** Improve edge-panel opening and collapse, retain the selected display across spaces and keep the Ultra level visible when supported by the model.

## Download

`codex-buddy-0.7.0-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` is the original prebuilt command-line package for macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon. It does not include an App or DMG. Source archives are available on this release page. For this historical version, follow the README bundled with the download. Desktop windows require macOS 15; native Liquid Glass requires macOS 26.

---

## 更新内容

- **简化工作台操作。** 单击眼睛收放聊天内工作台，双击往返桌面；独立窗口记住置顶选择。
- **减少视觉干扰。** 工具与刷新按悬停或键盘焦点显示，保留拖动编排和双击聚焦，移除重复操作。
- **建议与注释。** 同次运行切回聊天时恢复有效建议；修复编辑或删除聊天注释引起的侧栏切换。
- **设置与主题。** 直接打开分组网页设置，只读跟随 Codex 配色。
- **模型切换。** 改善贴边展开与收起，跨桌面保留所选显示器，并在模型支持时完整展示 Ultra 档位。

## 下载

`codex-buddy-0.7.0-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` 是原版预编译命令行包，支持 macOS 14 及以上的 Apple Silicon Mac，不包含 App 或 DMG。本页同时提供源码归档，历史版本请按下载包内的 README 使用。桌面窗口需要 macOS 15，原生液态材质需要 macOS 26。
